No default enablement, ResetAdapter, automatic rebinding, background service or tested-window operation. Continued TUI/multi-window persistent sessions remain UNIMPLEMENTED. Executable fixture verification is not native PASS. Default parallel make check hit the tool timeout; final serial complete check passed.
